title: git.repo.test: export ACCESS from --env, so getEnvironment makes no Account API call per test file
description:
## .what

git.repo.test exports `ACCESS=<env>` beside the `CONFIG=<env>` it already sets when `--env` is given.

## .why

sdk-environment's `getEnvironment` resolves access through a parser chain: the `ACCESS` env var first, then `iam:ListAccountAliases`, then `account:GetAccountInformation`. with `ACCESS` unset, every test FILE calls the Account API at setup (the cache is per process, and jest gives each file a fresh module registry). that API has a tiny request quota, so parallel suites throw `TooManyRequestsException` at setup.

measured 2026-11-18 on a 36-core grove: the svc-chat integration suite failed 5-11 tests per run, the victims moved each run, and every one was `TooManyRequestsException` from `getEnvAccessFromAwsAccountName`. a worker cap does not cure it: the quota is per account, so 9 crews x 4 workers is the same burst. `ACCESS` removes the call entirely.

## .done when

- `--env X` exports `ACCESS=X` to the test process
- a test pins it
